subject: A short cylindrical stoppered medicine bottle, broad straight neck, a chunky cork, wide gray glass body holding pale neutral gray liquid. ONE simple dark rectangular paper label, no writing. No red liquid, gold decoration, gems, dangling cords, cup or other props.

Neutral grayscale liquid and glass because the game tints this icon by potion effect. Chunky 32px pixel clusters. No red, no gilding, jewelry, text or extra props. Bent neck must distinguish it from a drinking bottle.

Chunky 32px pixel clusters, no red, gilding, jewelry, text or extra props.
